answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1738 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the tundra. The ridge index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the dawn queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. Each copy needs 13 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
